passages.text: Then the king summoned all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The king acted.
He sent a message.
He called all the elders of Judah.
He called all the elders of Jerusalem.
They gathered to him.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיַּאַסְפ֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And he went up to the house of the LORD with all the people of Judah and Jerusalem, as well as the priests and the prophets—all the people small and great—and in their hearing he read all the words of the Book of the Covenant that had been found in the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
King Josiah led the people.
He went up to the house of the LORD.
All the people of Judah went with him.
All the people living in Jerusalem went with him.
The priests went with him.
The prophets went with him.
All the people, from the least to the greatest, went with him.
Josiah read to them.
He read all the words from the Book of the Covenant.
They found this book in the house of the LORD.
Everyone listened as he read.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַל הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית־ יְהוָ֡ה וְכָל־ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָה֩ וְכָל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אִתּ֗וֹ וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם לְמִקָּטֹ֣ן וְעַד־ גָּד֑וֹל וַיִּקְרָ֣א בְאָזְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַבְּרִ֔ית הַנִּמְצָ֖א בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to follow the LORD and to keep His commandments, decrees, and statutes with all his heart and all his soul, and to carry out the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people entered into the covenant.
passages.sermon:
King Josiah stood by the pillar.
Josiah was the king of Judah.
He made a covenant before the LORD.
He promised to follow the LORD.
He promised to keep the LORD’s commandments.
He promised to keep the LORD’s decrees.
He promised to keep the LORD’s statutes.
He promised to do this with all his heart.
He promised to do this with all his soul.
He promised to carry out the words of the covenant.
These words were written in the book found in the house of the LORD.
All the people joined Josiah in making this covenant.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ עַֽל־ הָ֨עַמּ֜וּד וַיִּכְרֹ֥ת אֶֽת־ הַבְּרִ֣ית׀ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה לָלֶ֜כֶת אַחַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ וְלִשְׁמֹ֨ר מִצְוֺתָ֜יו וְאֶת־ עֵדְוֺתָ֤יו וְאֶת־ חֻקֹּתָיו֙ בְּכָל־ לֵ֣ב וּבְכָל־ נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְהָקִ֗ים אֶת־ דִּבְרֵי֙ הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֔את הַכְּתֻבִ֖ים עַל־ הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם בַּבְּרִֽית׃

passages.text: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, the priests second in rank, and the doorkeepers to remove from the temple of the LORD all the articles made for Baal, Asherah, and all the host of heaven. And he burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron and carried their ashes to Bethel.
passages.sermon:
King Josiah ruled Judah.
He wanted to remove idols from the temple of the LORD.
He gave a command to Hilkiah the high priest.
He also commanded the priests who were second in rank.
He commanded the doorkeepers as well.
He told them to take out all the articles made for Baal from the temple of the LORD.
He told them to remove all the articles made for Asherah.
He told them to remove all the articles made for all the host of heaven.
They took these items out of the temple.
They burned them outside Jerusalem.
They burned them in the fields of Kidron.
They carried the ashes to Bethel.
passages.original: וַיְצַ֣ו הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת־ חִלְקִיָּהוּ֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וְאֶת־ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁנֶה֮ וְאֶת־ שֹׁמְרֵ֣י הַסַּף֒ לְהוֹצִיא֙ מֵהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֗ים הָֽעֲשׂוּיִם֙ לַבַּ֣עַל וְלָֽאֲשֵׁרָ֔ה וּלְכֹ֖ל צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַֽיִּשְׂרְפֵ֞ם מִח֤וּץ לִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ בְּשַׁדְמ֣וֹת קִדְר֔וֹן וְנָשָׂ֥א אֶת־ עֲפָרָ֖ם בֵּֽית־ אֵֽל׃

passages.text: Josiah also did away with the idolatrous priests ordained by the kings of Judah to burn incense on the high places of the cities of Judah and in the places all around Jerusalem—those who had burned incense to Baal, to the sun and moon, to the constellations, and to all the host of heaven.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was the king of Judah.
Josiah removed the idolatrous priests.
The kings of Judah had appointed these priests.
These priests burned incense at the high places in the cities of Judah.
They also burned incense around Jerusalem.
Some priests burned incense to Baal.
Some priests burned incense to the sun.
Some priests burned incense to the moon.
Some priests burned incense to the constellations.
Some priests burned incense to all the host of heaven.
passages.original: וְהִשְׁבִּ֣ית אֶת־ הַכְּמָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽתְנוּ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיְקַטֵּ֤ר בַּבָּמוֹת֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמְסִבֵּ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאֶת־ הַֽמְקַטְּרִ֣ים לַבַּ֗עַל לַשֶּׁ֤מֶשׁ וְלַיָּרֵ֙חַ֙ וְלַמַּזָּל֔וֹת וּלְכֹ֖ל צְבָ֥א הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: He brought the Asherah pole from the house of the LORD to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem, and there he burned it, ground it to powder, and threw its dust on the graves of the common people.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was the king of Judah.
Josiah removed the Asherah pole from the house of the LORD.
He took the Asherah pole outside Jerusalem.
He brought it to the Kidron Valley.
He burned the Asherah pole in the Kidron Valley.
He ground the burned remains to powder.
He threw the powder on the graves of the common people.
passages.original: וַיֹּצֵ֣א אֶת־ הָאֲשֵׁרָה֩ מִבֵּ֨ית יְהוָ֜ה מִח֤וּץ לִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ אֶל־ נַ֣חַל קִדְר֔וֹן וַיִּשְׂרֹ֥ף אֹתָ֛הּ בְּנַ֥חַל קִדְר֖וֹן וַיָּ֣דֶק לְעָפָ֑ר וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶת־ עֲפָרָ֔הּ עַל־ קֶ֖בֶר בְּנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: He also tore down the quarters of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the house of the LORD, where the women had woven tapestries for Asherah.
passages.sermon:
King Josiah was a ruler of Judah.
He acted to remove idolatry from the land.
He tore down the rooms of the male shrine prostitutes.
These rooms were inside the house of the LORD.
Women had woven tapestries for Asherah in these rooms.
passages.original: וַיִּתֹּץ֙ אֶת־ בָּתֵּ֣י הַקְּדֵשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הַנָּשִׁ֗ים אֹרְג֥וֹת שָׁ֛ם בָּתִּ֖ים לָאֲשֵׁרָֽה׃

passages.text: Then Josiah brought all the priests from the cities of Judah and desecrated the high places, from Geba to Beersheba, where the priests had burned incense. He tore down the high places of the gates at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which was to the left of the city gate.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was the king of Judah.
Josiah gathered all the priests from the cities of Judah.
He desecrated the high places.
Priests had burned incense at these high places.
These high places were from Geba to Beersheba.
Josiah tore down the high places at the gates.
These gates were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua.
Joshua was the governor of the city.
This gate was to the left of the city gate.
passages.original: וַיָּבֵ֤א אֶת־ כָּל־ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ מֵעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיְטַמֵּ֣א אֶת־ הַבָּמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִטְּרוּ־ שָׁ֙מָּה֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מִגֶּ֖בַע עַד־ בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וְנָתַ֞ץ אֶת־ בָּמ֣וֹת הַשְּׁעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר־ פֶּ֜תַח שַׁ֤עַר יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ שַׂר־ הָעִ֔יר אֲשֶֽׁר־ עַל־ שְׂמֹ֥אול אִ֖ישׁ בְּשַׁ֥עַר הָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: Although the priests of the high places did not come up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, they ate unleavened bread with their fellow priests.
passages.sermon:
The priests of the high places did not go up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem.
These priests served at places of worship outside Jerusalem.
They did not serve at the main altar in the temple.
But they ate unleavened bread with their fellow priests.
They shared in the meals with the other priests.
passages.original: אַ֗ךְ לֹ֤א יַֽעֲלוּ֙ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י הַבָּמ֔וֹת אֶל־ מִזְבַּ֥ח יְהוָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֛י אִם־ אָכְל֥וּ מַצּ֖וֹת בְּת֥וֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: He also desecrated Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom so that no one could sacrifice his son or daughter in the fire to Molech.
passages.sermon:
King Josiah ruled Judah.
He acted to remove idolatry from the land.
He desecrated Topheth.
Topheth was in the Valley of Ben-hinnom.
People had used Topheth for child sacrifice.
They burned their sons and daughters in fire.
They did this as an offering to Molech.
Josiah made Topheth unfit for worship.
He did this so no one could sacrifice a child there again.
passages.original: וְטִמֵּ֣א אֶת־ הַתֹּ֔פֶת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּגֵ֣י בְנֵי הִנֹּ֑ם לְבִלְתִּ֗י לְהַעֲבִ֨יר אִ֜ישׁ אֶת־ בְּנ֧וֹ וְאֶת־ בִּתּ֛וֹ בָּאֵ֖שׁ לַמֹּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: And he removed from the entrance to the house of the LORD the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun. They were in the court near the chamber of an official named Nathan-melech. And Josiah burned up the chariots of the sun.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
The kings of Judah had dedicated horses to the sun.
They placed these horses at the entrance to the house of the LORD.
The horses stood in the court near the chamber of Nathan-melech.
Nathan-melech was an official.
Josiah removed these horses.
The kings of Judah had also dedicated chariots to the sun.
Josiah burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁבֵּ֣ת אֶת־ הַסּוּסִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנוּ֩ מַלְכֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֤ה לַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ מִבֹּ֣א בֵית־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ לִשְׁכַּת֙ נְתַן־ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַסָּרִ֔יס אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּפַּרְוָרִ֑ים וְאֶת־ מַרְכְּב֥וֹת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ שָׂרַ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: He pulled down the altars that the kings of Judah had set up on the roof near the upper chamber of Ahaz, and the altars that Manasseh had set up in the two courtyards of the house of the LORD. The king pulverized them there and threw their dust into the Kidron Valley.
passages.sermon:
King Josiah ruled Judah.
He acted to remove idolatry from the land.
The kings of Judah had built altars on the roof near the upper chamber of Ahaz.
Manasseh had built altars in the two courtyards of the house of the LORD.
King Josiah tore down these altars.
He broke them to pieces at that place.
He threw their dust into the Kidron Valley.
passages.original: וְאֶֽת־ הַֽמִּזְבְּח֡וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַגָּג֩ עֲלִיַּ֨ת אָחָ֜ז אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֣וּ׀ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וְאֶת־ הַֽמִּזְבְּחוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה בִּשְׁתֵּ֛י חַצְר֥וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה נָתַ֣ץ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיָּ֣רָץ מִשָּׁ֔ם וְהִשְׁלִ֥יךְ אֶת־ עֲפָרָ֖ם אֶל־ נַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: The king also desecrated the high places east of Jerusalem, to the south of the Mount of Corruption, which King Solomon of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
passages.sermon:
King Josiah ruled over Judah.
He acted to remove idolatry from the land.
He desecrated the high places near Jerusalem.
These high places stood east of the city.
They were south of the Mount of Corruption.
King Solomon of Israel had built these high places.
He built them for Ashtoreth, the abomination of the Sidonians.
He built them for Chemosh, the abomination of the Moabites.
He built them for Milcom, the abomination of the Ammonites.
King Josiah made these places unclean.
passages.original: וְֽאֶת־ הַבָּמ֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֮ מִימִ֣ין לְהַר־ הַמַּשְׁחִית֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ֠נָה שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לְעַשְׁתֹּ֣רֶת׀ שִׁקֻּ֣ץ צִידֹנִ֗ים וְלִכְמוֹשׁ֙ שִׁקֻּ֣ץ מוֹאָ֔ב וּלְמִלְכֹּ֖ם תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ עַמּ֑וֹן טִמֵּ֖א הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: He smashed the sacred pillars to pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and covered the sites with human bones.
passages.sermon:
King Josiah acted with determination.
He broke the sacred pillars into pieces.
He cut down the Asherah poles.
He filled those places with human bones.
passages.original: וְשִׁבַּר֙ אֶת־ הַמַּצֵּב֔וֹת וַיִּכְרֹ֖ת אֶת־ הָאֲשֵׁרִ֑ים וַיְמַלֵּ֥א אֶת־ מְקוֹמָ֖ם עַצְמ֥וֹת אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: He even pulled down the altar at Bethel, the high place set up by Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused Israel to sin. Then he burned the high place, ground it to powder, and burned the Asherah pole.
passages.sermon:
King Josiah acted in Jerusalem and the surrounding region.
He destroyed places of idol worship.
He went to Bethel.
Bethel had an altar and a high place.
Jeroboam son of Nebat built this high place.
Jeroboam led Israel into sin by building it.
Josiah tore down the altar at Bethel.
He also tore down the high place.
He burned the high place.
He ground it into powder.
He burned the Asherah pole.
passages.original: וְגַ֨ם אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֜חַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּבֵֽית־ אֵ֗ל הַבָּמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה יָרָבְעָ֤ם בֶּן־ נְבָט֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱטִ֣יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גַּ֣ם אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֧חַ הַה֛וּא וְאֶת־ הַבָּמָ֖ה נָתָ֑ץ וַיִּשְׂרֹ֧ף אֶת־ הַבָּמָ֛ה הֵדַ֥ק לְעָפָ֖ר וְשָׂרַ֥ף אֲשֵׁרָֽה׃

passages.text: And as Josiah turned, he saw the tombs there on the hillside, and he sent someone to take the bones out of the tombs, and he burned them on the altar to defile it, according to the word of the LORD proclaimed by the man of God who had foretold these things.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was the king of Judah.
Josiah turned and looked at the hillside.
He saw tombs on the hillside.
Josiah sent men to the tombs.
The men took bones out of the tombs.
Josiah burned the bones on the altar.
He did this to make the altar unclean.
The man of God had spoken the word of the LORD.
The man of God had foretold these things would happen.
passages.original: וַיִּ֣פֶן יֹאשִׁיָּ֗הוּ וַיַּ֨רְא אֶת־ הַקְּבָרִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁם֙ בָּהָ֔ר וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֶת־ הָֽעֲצָמוֹת֙ מִן־ הַקְּבָרִ֔ים וַיִּשְׂרֹ֥ף עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וַֽיְטַמְּאֵ֑הוּ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר קָרָא֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָרָ֔א אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Then the king asked, “What is this monument I see?” And the men of the city replied, “It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and pronounced these things that you have done to the altar of Bethel.”
passages.sermon:
King Josiah saw a monument.
He asked, “What is this monument I see?”
The men of the city answered him.
They said, “This is the tomb of the man of God.”
This man came from Judah.
He spoke these words about the altar at Bethel.
He said what you have now done to the altar.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֚ה הַצִּיּ֣וּן הַלָּ֔ז אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֣י רֹאֶ֑ה וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֜יו אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָעִ֗יר הַקֶּ֤בֶר אִישׁ־ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֣א מִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתָ עַ֖ל הַמִּזְבַּ֥ח בֵּֽית־ אֵֽל׃

passages.text: “Let him rest,” said Josiah. “Do not let anyone disturb his bones.” So they left his bones undisturbed, along with those of the prophet who had come from Samaria.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was the king of Judah.
Josiah spoke to the people.
Josiah said, “Let him rest.”
Josiah said, “Do not let anyone disturb his bones.”
The people obeyed Josiah.
They did not move the bones of the man of God.
They also did not move the bones of the prophet who had come from Samaria.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַנִּ֣יחוּ ל֔וֹ אִ֖ישׁ אַל־ יָנַ֣ע עַצְמֹתָ֑יו וַֽיְמַלְּטוּ֙ עַצְמֹתָ֔יו אֵ֚ת עַצְמ֣וֹת הַנָּבִ֔יא אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֖א מִשֹּׁמְרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Just as Josiah had done at Bethel, so also in the cities of Samaria he removed all the shrines of the high places set up by the kings of Israel who had provoked the LORD to anger.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was the king of Judah.
Josiah acted with zeal for the LORD.
The kings of Israel had built shrines for worship in the cities of Samaria.
These shrines were called high places.
The kings of Israel built these high places to provoke the LORD to anger.
Josiah removed all these shrines in the cities of Samaria.
Josiah did to these shrines just as he had done at Bethel.
passages.original: וְגַם֩ אֶת־ כָּל־ בָּתֵּ֨י הַבָּמ֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ בְּעָרֵ֣י שֹׁמְר֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֜וּ מַלְכֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְהַכְעִ֔יס הֵסִ֖יר יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לָהֶ֔ם כְּכָל־ הַֽמַּעֲשִׂ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בְּבֵֽית־ אֵֽל׃

passages.text: On the altars he slaughtered all the priests of the high places, and he burned human bones on them. Then he returned to Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
King Josiah was the ruler of Judah.
Josiah acted with zeal for the LORD.
Josiah went to the high places.
The high places had altars.
The priests of the high places served false gods.
Josiah slaughtered all the priests of the high places on the altars.
Josiah burned human bones on those altars.
After this, Josiah returned to Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַ֠יִּזְבַּח אֶת־ כָּל־ כֹּהֲנֵ֨י הַבָּמ֤וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁם֙ עַל־ הַֽמִּזְבְּח֔וֹת וַיִּשְׂרֹ֛ף אֶת־ עַצְמ֥וֹת אָדָ֖ם עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּ֖שָׁב יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: The king commanded all the people, “Keep the Passover of the LORD your God, as it is written in this Book of the Covenant.”
passages.sermon:
King Josiah ruled over Judah.
Josiah was faithful to the LORD.
Josiah gave a command to all the people.
He said, “Keep the Passover for the LORD your God.”
He told them to do it as it is written in this Book of the Covenant.
passages.original: וַיְצַ֤ו הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר עֲשׂ֣וּ פֶ֔סַח לַֽיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֑ם כַּכָּת֕וּב עַ֛ל סֵ֥פֶר הַבְּרִ֖ית הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: No such Passover had been observed from the days of the judges who had governed Israel through all the days of the kings of Israel and Judah.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel had leaders called judges.
These judges governed Israel long ago.
After the judges, Israel had kings.
Judah also had kings.
From the time of the judges until all the days of the kings of Israel and Judah, no Passover like this had been kept.
No one had observed a Passover like this before.
passages.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א נַֽעֲשָׂה֙ כַּפֶּ֣סַח הַזֶּ֔ה מִימֵי֙ הַשֹּׁ֣פְטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁפְט֖וּ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכֹ֗ל יְמֵ֛י מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: But in the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign, this Passover was observed to the LORD in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
Josiah ruled in Jerusalem.
Josiah reigned for eighteen years.
In the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign, the people kept the Passover.
They observed the Passover for the LORD.
They celebrated the Passover in Jerusalem.
passages.original: כִּ֗י אִם־ בִּשְׁמֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ נַעֲשָׂ֞ה הַפֶּ֧סַח הַזֶּ֛ה לַיהוָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Furthermore, Josiah removed the mediums and spiritists, the household gods and idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem. He did this to carry out the words of the law written in the book that Hilkiah the priest had found in the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
Josiah removed the mediums.
Josiah removed the spiritists.
Josiah removed the household gods.
Josiah removed the idols.
Josiah removed all the abominations seen in the land of Judah.
Josiah removed all the abominations seen in Jerusalem.
Josiah did this to obey the words of the law.
The words of the law were written in the book.
Hilkiah the priest found this book in the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וְגַ֣ם אֶת־ הָאֹב֣וֹת וְאֶת־ הַ֠יִּדְּעֹנִים וְאֶת־ הַתְּרָפִ֨ים וְאֶת־ הַגִּלֻּלִ֜ים וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַשִּׁקֻּצִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִרְאוּ֙ בְּאֶ֤רֶץ יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בִּעֵ֖ר יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ לְ֠מַעַן הָקִ֞ים אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֤י הַתּוֹרָה֙ הַכְּתֻבִ֣ים עַל־ הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָצָ֛א חִלְקִיָּ֥הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Neither before nor after Josiah was there any king like him, who turned to the LORD with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his strength, according to all the Law of Moses.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
Josiah turned to the LORD.
He turned to the LORD with all his heart.
He turned to the LORD with all his soul.
He turned to the LORD with all his strength.
He followed all the Law of Moses.
No king before Josiah was like him.
No king after Josiah was like him.
passages.original: וְכָמֹהוּ֩ לֹֽא־ הָיָ֨ה לְפָנָ֜יו מֶ֗לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֤ב אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ בְּכָל־ לְבָב֤וֹ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשׁוֹ֙ וּבְכָל־ מְאֹד֔וֹ כְּכֹ֖ל תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְאַחֲרָ֖יו לֹֽא־ קָ֥ם כָּמֹֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Nevertheless, the LORD did not turn away from the fury of His burning anger, which was kindled against Judah because of all that Manasseh had done to provoke Him to anger.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD felt great anger against Judah.
Manasseh was a former king of Judah.
Manasseh did many evil things.
Manasseh provoked the LORD to anger.
Because of all these actions, the LORD’s anger burned against Judah.
The LORD did not turn away from His fierce anger.
passages.original: אַ֣ךְ׀ לֹֽא־ שָׁ֣ב יְהוָ֗ה מֵחֲר֤וֹן אַפּוֹ֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־ חָרָ֥ה אַפּ֖וֹ בִּֽיהוּדָ֑ה עַ֚ל כָּל־ הַכְּעָסִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִכְעִיס֖וֹ מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

passages.text: For the LORD had said, “I will remove Judah from My sight, just as I removed Israel. I will reject this city Jerusalem, which I chose, and the temple of which I said, ‘My Name shall be there.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke.
The LORD said He would remove Judah from His presence.
The LORD had already removed Israel from His presence.
The LORD said He would reject Jerusalem.
The LORD had chosen Jerusalem.
The LORD said He would reject the temple in Jerusalem.
The LORD had said about the temple, “My Name shall be there.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה גַּ֤ם אֶת־ יְהוּדָה֙ אָסִיר֙ מֵעַ֣ל פָּנַ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲסִרֹ֖תִי אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ֠מָאַסְתִּי אֶת־ הָעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֤את אֲשֶׁר־ בָּחַ֙רְתִּי֙ אֶת־ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְאֶת־ הַבַּ֔יִת אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתִּי יִהְיֶ֥ה שְׁמִ֖י שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Josiah, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
Josiah did many things.
Josiah accomplished much.
Writers recorded the rest of Josiah’s acts.
They wrote all his accomplishments.
They wrote these things in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah.
passages.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: At the end of Josiah’s reign, Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt marched up to help the king of Assyria at the Euphrates River. King Josiah went out to confront him, but Neco faced him and killed him at Megiddo.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh Neco was the king of Egypt.
He marched up to the Euphrates River.
He went to help the king of Assyria.
This happened at the end of King Josiah’s reign.
King Josiah was the king of Judah.
Josiah went out to confront Pharaoh Neco.
Pharaoh Neco saw Josiah at Megiddo.
Pharaoh Neco killed Josiah at Megiddo.
passages.original: בְּיָמָ֡יו עָלָה֩ פַרְעֹ֨ה נְכֹ֧ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֛יִם עַל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר עַל־ נְהַר־ פְּרָ֑ת וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֙הוּ֙ לִקְרָאת֔וֹ וַיְמִיתֵ֙הוּ֙ בִּמְגִדּ֔וֹ כִּרְאֹת֖וֹ אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: From Megiddo his servants carried his body in a chariot, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah, anointed him, and made him king in place of his father.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
Josiah died at Megiddo.
His servants carried his dead body from Megiddo in a chariot.
They brought his body to Jerusalem.
They buried Josiah in his own tomb.
The people of the land took Jehoahaz.
Jehoahaz was the son of Josiah.
The people anointed Jehoahaz.
They made Jehoahaz king instead of his father.
passages.original: וַיַּרְכִּבֻ֨הוּ עֲבָדָ֥יו מֵת֙ מִמְּגִדּ֔וֹ וַיְבִאֻ֙הוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֖הוּ בִּקְבֻֽרָת֑וֹ וַיִּקַּ֣ח עַם־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־ יְהֽוֹאָחָז֙ בֶּן־ יֹ֣אשִׁיָּ֔הוּ וַיִּמְשְׁח֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ וַיַּמְלִ֥יכוּ אֹת֖וֹ תַּ֥חַת אָבִֽיו׃פ

passages.text: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
passages.sermon:
Jehoahaz became king of Judah.
He was twenty-three years old.
He ruled in Jerusalem.
He reigned for three months.
His mother was Hamutal.
Hamutal was the daughter of Jeremiah.
She was from Libnah.
passages.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְשָׁלֹ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ יְהוֹאָחָ֣ז בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ חֲמוּטַ֥ל בַּֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִלִּבְנָֽה׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as his fathers had done.
passages.sermon:
Jehoahaz was king in Jerusalem.
He did evil things.
The LORD saw his evil actions.
Jehoahaz acted like his fathers before him.
His fathers also did evil.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: And Pharaoh Neco imprisoned Jehoahaz at Riblah in the land of Hamath so that he could not reign in Jerusalem, and he imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh Neco was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh Neco captured Jehoahaz.
Pharaoh Neco imprisoned Jehoahaz at Riblah.
Riblah is in the land of Hamath.
Pharaoh Neco did this while Jehoahaz was king in Jerusalem.
Pharaoh Neco stopped Jehoahaz from ruling in Jerusalem.
Pharaoh Neco made Judah pay a heavy tax.
He demanded one hundred talents of silver.
He also demanded one talent of gold.
passages.original: וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ֩ פַרְעֹ֨ה נְכֹ֤ה בְרִבְלָה֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֔ת בִּמְלֹךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיִּתֶּן־ עֹ֙נֶשׁ֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵאָ֥ה כִכַּר־ כֶּ֖סֶף וְכִכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: Then Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of his father Josiah, and he changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. But Neco took Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt, where he died.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh Neco was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim king over Judah.
Eliakim was the son of Josiah.
Josiah was the former king of Judah.
Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim king instead of his father Josiah.
Pharaoh Neco changed Eliakim’s name.
He called him Jehoiakim.
Pharaoh Neco took Jehoahaz away.
Jehoahaz was another son of Josiah.
Pharaoh Neco brought Jehoahaz to Egypt.
Jehoahaz died in Egypt.
passages.original: וַיַּמְלֵךְ֩ פַּרְעֹ֨ה נְכֹ֜ה אֶת־ אֶלְיָקִ֣ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֗הוּ תַּ֚חַת יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֔יו וַיַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים וְאֶת־ יְהוֹאָחָ֣ז לָקָ֔ח וַיָּבֹ֥א מִצְרַ֖יִם וַיָּ֥מָת שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: So Jehoiakim paid the silver and gold to Pharaoh Neco, but to meet Pharaoh’s demand he taxed the land and exacted the silver and the gold from the people, each according to his wealth.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiakim was king of Judah.
Pharaoh Neco demanded silver and gold from Judah.
Jehoiakim gave the silver and gold to Pharaoh Neco.
Jehoiakim needed to collect this money from the people.
He taxed the land to meet Pharaoh’s demand.
He took silver and gold from the people of the land.
He required each person to pay according to his wealth.
He gave the collected silver and gold to Pharaoh Neco.
passages.original: וְהַכֶּ֣סֶף וְהַזָּהָ֗ב נָתַ֤ן יְהוֹיָקִים֙ לְפַרְעֹ֔ה אַ֚ךְ הֶעֱרִ֣יךְ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ לָתֵ֥ת אֶת־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף עַל־ פִּ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה אִ֣ישׁ כְּעֶרְכּ֗וֹ נָגַ֞שׂ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָב֙ אֶת־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ לָתֵ֖ת לְפַרְעֹ֥ה נְכֹֽה׃ס

passages.text: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Zebidah daughter of Pedaiah; she was from Rumah.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiakim became king when he was twenty-five years old.
He ruled in Jerusalem.
He ruled for eleven years.
His mother was Zebidah.
Zebidah was the daughter of Pedaiah.
Zebidah came from Rumah.
passages.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָ֨ה יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ זְבִידָה בַת־ פְּדָיָ֖ה מִן־ רוּמָֽה׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as his fathers had done.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiakim was king of Judah.
He did evil things.
The LORD saw Jehoiakim’s actions.
Jehoiakim’s actions displeased the LORD.
Jehoiakim acted like his fathers before him.
His fathers also did evil things.
Jehoiakim followed their example.
